about: The Workbench's bundled concept probes. Each concept is two poles of example replies; a probe is the difference of the poles' mean activations at one layer. Entries with a `source` reuse the repo's contrast pairs from steerlab.data (the sandbagging probe's own data). Plain-text entries are scored as the assistant's reply to `prompt`.
